thread_text:
maria: Quick check — I'm about to roll out the ExternalSecrets helm change that switches our payments service to sync from Vault kv-v2 paths (instead of the adhoc scripts). Plan is A/B: apply new helm values to payments-staging then payments-prod after testing. Anyone see a risk with Vault key rotation happening during the rollout?

sam: Post the helm values you're applying (sanitized). Make sure the targetSecretTemplate and template metadata.name keep existing secret names or pods won't pick them up. Also confirm the ExternalSecrets controller version supports kv-v2 metadata versioning.

maria: Pasted sanitized values below. Note `refreshInterval` set to 1m to pick up rotations quickly.
```yaml
externalSecrets:
  backend: vault
  vaultMount: kubernetes
  kvVersion: v2
  secrets:
    - path: secret/data/payments/staging
      target: payments-db-creds
      refreshInterval: 1m
      template:
        data: {}
        metadata:
          annotations:
            reloader.stakater.com/reload: "payments-deployment"
```

david: Two quick notes: 1) If Vault does a key rotation and the secret version changes, ExternalSecrets will create/update the k8s secret, but the pods won't reload unless you trigger it. We should add either an annotation that our reloader respects or patch the deployment to add `spec.template.metadata.annotations.secret-reload-ts` with a timestamp during rollout.

2) Ensure the ExternalSecrets Role has `auth/*` read on the Vault mount for kv-v2 metadata. We've tripped on that before (401 on read with v2 path).

lee: For production, I'd avoid 1m refresh in prod right away — it spikes vault read QPS. Suggest 5m for prod, 1m for staging. Also check quota with ops.

maria: Good call. I'll set staging 1m, prod 5m. Re: reload, will add a tiny deployment hook to patch `secret-reload-ts` on successful secret update during canary. Any objections to a short-lived post-sync job that patches the deployment?

sam: Sounds good. Implementation detail: prefer using `kubectl rollout restart deployment/payments` in the post-sync job only for canary pods, otherwise use the annotation so rollout is controlled by the rollout controller.

infra-bot: CI:helm-lint succeeded for chart `external-secrets` — PR #4287 linked: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4287

maria: I'll push changes to PR #4287 now: - staging values refreshInterval=1m - prod values refreshInterval=5m - added `reloader` annotation and a post-sync job to patch `secret-reload-ts` on canary.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary rollout for payments-staging at 2026-02-15T13:45:00Z.

david: After canary, watch the Vault read metrics (vault.kv.reads) and k8s secret churn. If reads spike >20% or etcd object churn is high, revert refreshInterval to 5m for staging and iterate.

maria: Will monitor and post results here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
